title: card.monitor Request Application Programming Interface (API) Schema
description: When a Notecard is in [monitor mode](https://dev.blues.io/notecard/notecard-walkthrough/working-with-the-notecard-aux-pins/#using-monitor-mode), this API is used to configure the general-purpose `AUX1`-`AUX4` pins to test and monitor Notecard activity.

count.description: The number of pulses to send to the overridden AUX pin LED. To return the LED to its default behavior, use `"off": true` along with the `mode` of the LED.

mode.description:
Can be set to one of `green`, `red` or `yellow` to temporarily override the behavior of an AUX pin LED.

See [Using Monitor Mode](https://dev.blues.io/notecard/notecard-walkthrough/working-with-the-notecard-aux-pins/#using-monitor-mode) for additional details.

sub-descriptions.description: Temporarily override the behavior of the green AUX pin LED.
Temporarily override the behavior of the red AUX pin LED.
Temporarily override the behavior of the yellow AUX pin LED.

off.description: Set to `true`, along with a `mode`, to clear an override and return that AUX pin LED to its default behavior.

on.description: Set to `true`, along with a `mode`, to turn that AUX pin LED on continuously.

usb.description: Set to `true` to configure LED behavior so that it is only active when the Notecard is connected to USB power.

annotations.title: note
annotations.description: Utilizing these pins requires a physical connection to each pin, separate from a connection to the Notecard's M.2 connector.

samples.title: Override LED Behavior
samples.description: Configure the green LED to pulse 5 times.

samples.title: Turn an LED On Continuously
samples.description: Override the red LED and hold it on until the override is cleared.

samples.title: Return an LED to its Default Behavior
samples.description: Clear any override on the green LED so it resumes signaling Notecard activity.

samples.title: Override an LED Only on USB Power
samples.description: Configure the yellow LED to pulse 3 times, but only while the Notecard is connected to USB power.
